intent: Produce a gene-by-sample matrix of integer read counts for DESeq2 from these two single-end samples (ctrl.bam, treated.bam; 150 nt reads, aligned to the genome of annotation.gtf), quantifying the annotated transcripts with StringTie and converting its output with the StringTie helper script.
silent_error: StringTie does not output counts, only coverage; prepDE.py reconstructs counts as ceil(coverage x transcript length / read length). The read length is a parameter (-l / --length) whose default is 75 ('the average read length [default: 75]'), and prepDE.py cannot see the real read length in the GTF. With 150 nt reads every count comes out exactly twice the true one (e.g. 40 instead of 20 for LRRC8X in ctrl). prepDE.py exits 0, prints nothing, and writes a perfectly formed gene_count_matrix.csv, so the doubled counts go on to DESeq2 (and would differ in scale from counts of samples with another read length). The clean run passes -l 150.
